preprocessing.categorical_encoding: scikit-learn LabelEncoder applied before the train/test split
preprocessing.pca: scikit-learn PCA; fit on training split, transform held-out split; random_state=42
preprocessing.quantum_scaling: MinMaxScaler(feature_range=(0, pi)) fitted after PCA on training split
preprocessing.classical_pca_scaling: StandardScaler fitted after PCA on training split
preprocessing.qubit_dimension_mismatch: truncate excess PCA components or zero-pad missing components
preprocessing.engineered_classical_features: engagement counts; log1p counts and totals; safe count ratios and engagement fractions; publication year/month/day-of-week; top-20 Category and Post Type one-hot indicators with other category

classical_baselines.five_fold_cv: StratifiedKFold(shuffle=True, random_state=42); PCA(2) is fitted before folds, while full-feature scaler is fit within fold pipelines

quantum_implementation.ideal_backend: exact Qiskit statevector simulation with cached feature states

feature_maps.pauli_xyz: Qiskit PauliFeatureMap; paulis X,Y,Z; full entanglement
feature_maps.ry_custom: one-layer circuit with one RY(theta_i) per qubit; reps does not alter this circuit

pegasos.sampling: one uniform training example per update; seeded NumPy generator; update on margin < 1

condition_number: largest positive eigenvalue / smallest positive eigenvalue after centering and diagonal ridge 1e-8
spectral_gap: largest eigenvalue - second-largest eigenvalue after centering and diagonal ridge 1e-8

noise.one_qubit_error: depolarizing_error(p, 1) on rx, ry, rz, x, y, z, h, s, sdg, t, tdg

geometry_sweep.design: Feature-map and depth sweeps fix qubits=2; Pauli-XYZ PCA/qubit tradeoff spans 2, 3, and 4 qubits at PCA dimensions 2, 3, and 4.

seed_sweep_support_counts.classical_model: RBF SVC, C=1.0, gamma=scale, on StandardScaler-transformed PCA features
seed_sweep_support_counts.classical_count: sum of scikit-learn SVC n_support_ across classes
seed_sweep_support_counts.quantum_model: Pauli-XYZ quantum kernel, 2 qubits, 2 repetitions, Pegasos lambda=0.02, 100 sampled updates
seed_sweep_support_counts.quantum_count: distinct training examples added to Pegasos active set after a margin-violating update
seed_sweep_support_counts.count_comparison: descriptive solver-specific counts only; no ratio, significance test, or efficiency claim

cross_dataset_scope.breast_cancer: classification sanity check only; fake-news geometry protocol not replicated
cross_dataset_scope.welfake_liar: excluded from claims and manuscript tables due to conflicting runs and incomplete provenance
